model.name: Poolside Laguna S 2.1
model.shape: E256 K3072 N1024+1024 natural pp512 routing

candidate.geometry: production 128 output columns x 32 routed rows, local128
candidate.premise: prefetch the next direct wave-column T16 Q4 K32 record into registers while current K32 packed dots execute
candidate.invariants: same resident T16 bytes, D8 activation double buffer, output ownership, LDS allocation, barriers, packed-dot order, FP32 K order, and BF16 stores
candidate.distinction: register-only weight software pipeline; unlike rejected K64 staging it does not add an activation or weight LDS stage

correctness.red: The production-shape CPU-reference parameter failed because the wrapper had no weight_prefetch specialization.
correctness.green: The uneven/empty expert fixture passed the CPU-reference KL/top-1 gate.

leaf.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_q4_k_mmq_leaf_bench.py --rows 512 --modes t16-mmq128x32-d8-f32-wavecols-direct-doublebuf,t16-mmq128x32-d8-f32-wavecols-direct-doublebuf-weight-prefetch --warmups 2 --samples 9 --burst 3 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --output /tmp/laguna-q4-weight-prefetch-leaf.json
leaf.timing: counter-rotated HIP events; each mode includes the unchanged D8 activation pack

rocprof.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --output-format csv -d /tmp/laguna-q4-weight-prefetch-rocprof -- .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_q4_k_mmq_leaf_bench.py --rows 512 --modes t16-mmq128x32-d8-f32-wavecols-direct-doublebuf,t16-mmq128x32-d8-f32-wavecols-direct-doublebuf-weight-prefetch --warmups 0 --samples 1 --burst 1 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --output /tmp/laguna-q4-weight-prefetch-rocprof-child.json

decision.reason: the second live decoded record raises VGPR 88 -> 104 and regresses every actual-weight sample by 6.88%; software overlap cannot repay the occupancy/register cost
removed: HIP helper, template parameter, and export
